entities.name: Gastal Endriders
entities.description: Racing team and gang that fled Gastal.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Plane hosting the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who mind-controlled Fortune to recover Loot.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after whose end the Omenpaths opened.

events.summary: After the invasion ended and the Omenpaths opened, Endrider gangs left Gastal and ran out of fuel.
events.quote: Endrider gangs rode their machines to freedom, leaving Gastal without a look in the rearview mirror

events.summary: Fortune's gang is stranded on Avishkar and enters the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
events.quote: they were stranded on Avishkar and quickly found their way into the Ghirapur Grand Prix

events.summary: In the final stage, Fortune's vehicle is wrecked and Jace mind controls her while trying to recover Loot.
events.quote: she was mind controlled by Jace Beleren

relations.quote: is the captain of the Gastal Endriders racing team
